title: Elevators in Mallworld
content: I just stumbled upon this community a few days ago after seeing it on TikTok. I’ve been dreaming of Mallworld every night for almost 5 years now, ever since I got on antidepressants. Now for my question: do you also have elevators in Mallworld that don’t work like normal elevators? You have to add up numbers to get to the right floor, they sometimes stop and open in the middle of the ride very high up or they’re moving really fast and you have to hop onto the moving elevator. All these things apply to different ones I dream of, but each elevator always works the same way every time. Just each one differently. The one that stresses me out the most tho is the first one, especially when you want to reach higher floors you have to change the elevator halfway through but calculate it beforehand. It’s hard to explain but it all makes sense in the dreams. Really looking forward to how you guys experience elevators.
